mapper.update: UPDATE monographs SET slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, newspaper_source_id = #{newspaperSourceId}, edition_date = #{editionDate}, edition_date_to = #{editionDateTo}, editorial_note = #{editorialNote}, colophon = #{colophon}, central_question = #{centralQuestion}, method_note = #{methodNote}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, citation_format_template = #{citationFormatTemplate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE monographs SET status = #{status}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE monographs SET is_active = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM monographs WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM monographs WHERE slug = #{slug}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monographs WHERE slug = #{slug})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monographs WHERE slug = #{slug} AND id != #{excludeId})

SELECT m.id, m.slug, m.title, m.subtitle, m.edition_date as editionDate, m.editorial_note as editorialNote, m.colophon, m.central_question as centralQuestion, m.method_note as methodNote, m.cover_image_url as coverImageUrl, m.citation_format_template as citationFormatTemplate, m.status, m.view_count as viewCount, m.newspaper_source_id as newspaperSourceId, ns.name as newspaperSourceName, ns.slug as newspaperSourceSlug FROM monographs m JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON ns.id = m.newspaper_source_id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.is_active = true
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT me.monograph_id, COUNT(*) as total_articles, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE me.role IN ('main_arc','counterpoint','interlude','peripheral')) as in_book_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE me.role = 'appendix') as appendix_count, SUM(na.word_count) FILTER (WHERE me.role IN ('main_arc','counterpoint','interlude','peripheral','appendix')) as word_count FROM monograph_entries me JOIN newspaper_articles na ON na.id = me.article_id GROUP BY me.monograph_id ) ec ON ec.monograph_id = m.id
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.slug, m.title, m.subtitle, m.edition_date as editionDate, m.cover_image_url as coverImageUrl, m.status, m.view_count as viewCount, m.published_at as publishedAt, ns.name as newspaperSourceName, ns.slug as newspaperSourceSlug, COALESCE(ec.total_articles, 0) as totalArticles, COALESCE(ec.in_book_count, 0) as inBookCount, COALESCE(ec.appendix_count, 0) as appendixCount, COALESCE(ec.word_count, 0) as wordCount, CEIL(COALESCE(ec.word_count, 0) / 200.0)::int as readingTimeMinutes FROM monographs m JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON ns.id = m.newspaper_source_id
WHERE m.is_active = true AND m.status = 'published' ORDER BY m.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, m.edition_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT slug, updated_at as updatedAt FROM monographs WHERE is_active = true AND status = 'published' ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monograph_chapters (monograph_id, chapter_order, title, narrative_summary) VALUES (#{monographId}, #{chapterOrder}, #{title}, #{narrativeSummary})
mapper.select: SELECT id, chapter_order as chapterOrder, title, narrative_summary as narrativeSummary FROM monograph_chapters WHERE monograph_id = #{monographId} ORDER BY chapter_order

SELECT me.article_id as articleId, na.slug as articleSlug, na.title as title, na.subtitle as subtitle, (LEFT(na.content, 220) || CASE WHEN LENGTH(na.content) > 220 THEN '…' ELSE '' END) as leadSnippet, na.page_number as pageNumber, me.column_info as columnInfo, na.publish_date as publishDate, na.word_count as wordCount, na.parent_article_id as parentArticleId, na.article_level as articleLevel, ns.slug as sourceSlug, ns.name as sourceName, me.role as role, me.text_status as textStatus, me.position_label as positionLabel, me.editorial_note as editorialNote, me.entry_order as entryOrder, me.chapter_id as chapterId FROM monograph_entries me JOIN newspaper_articles na ON na.id = me.article_id JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON ns.id = na.source_id WHERE me.monograph_id = #{monographId} ORDER BY CASE me.role WHEN 'main_arc' THEN 1 WHEN 'counterpoint' THEN 2 WHEN 'interlude' THEN 3 WHEN 'peripheral' THEN 4 WHEN 'appendix' THEN 5 WHEN 'carry_forward' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END, me.chapter_id NULLS LAST, me.entry_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monograph_critical_notes (monograph_id, note_number, note_text, related_article_id) VALUES (#{monographId}, #{noteNumber}, #{noteText}, #{relatedArticleId})
mapper.select: SELECT mcn.note_number as number, mcn.note_text as noteText, mcn.related_article_id as relatedArticleId, na.slug as relatedArticleSlug, ns.slug as relatedArticleSourceSlug FROM monograph_critical_notes mcn LEFT JOIN newspaper_articles na ON na.id = mcn.related_article_id LEFT JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON ns.id = na.source_id WHERE mcn.monograph_id = #{monographId} ORDER BY mcn.note_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monograph_glossary (monograph_id, term, definition, term_order) VALUES (#{monographId}, #{term}, #{definition}, #{termOrder})
INSERT INTO monograph_index_entries (monograph_id, index_type, label) VALUES (#{monographId}, #{indexType}, #{label})
mapper.select: SELECT mie.label as label, na.id as articleId, na.slug as articleSlug, ns.slug as sourceSlug, na.title as title FROM monograph_index_entries mie JOIN monograph_index_refs mir ON mir.index_entry_id = mie.id JOIN newspaper_articles na ON na.id = mir.article_id JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON ns.id = na.source_id WHERE mie.monograph_id = #{monographId} AND mie.index_type = #{indexType} ORDER BY mie.label
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monograph_entries WHERE monograph_id = #{monographId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monograph_chapters WHERE monograph_id = #{monographId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monograph_entries me JOIN newspaper_articles na ON na.id = me.article_id WHERE me.monograph_id = #{monographId} AND na.is_active = false
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monograph_views WHERE viewer_hash = #{viewerHash})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monograph_views (monograph_id, user_id, ip_address, user_agent, viewer_hash) VALUES (#{monographId}, #{userId}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{viewerHash}) ON CONFLICT (viewer_hash) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE monographs SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{monographId}
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM newspaper_sources WHERE id = #{sourceId}

SELECT na.id as articleId, na.title as title, na.subtitle as subtitle, na.slug as slug, na.page_number as pageNumber, na.word_count as wordCount, na.publish_date as publishDate, na.parent_article_id as parentArticleId, na.article_level as articleLevel FROM newspaper_articles na WHERE na.source_id = #{sourceId} AND na.is_active = true AND na.publish_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY na.publish_date, na.page_number, na.id
SELECT slug FROM newspaper_sources WHERE id = #{sourceId}

SELECT id, slug, title, edition_date as editionDate, cover_image_url as coverImageUrl FROM monographs WHERE newspaper_source_id = #{sourceId} AND is_active = true AND status = 'published' AND (edition_date < #{editionDate} OR (edition_date = #{editionDate} AND id < #{id})) ORDER BY edition_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, slug, title, edition_date as editionDate, cover_image_url as coverImageUrl FROM monographs WHERE newspaper_source_id = #{sourceId} AND is_active = true AND status = 'published' AND (edition_date > #{editionDate} OR (edition_date = #{editionDate} AND id > #{id})) ORDER BY edition_date ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
